card.name: "Have" after in vitro studies
card.fires_on: The word "have" right after a study-type subject such as "in vitro studies" or "interaction studies in humans". It is found in drug interaction and metabolism sections.

modes.label: In vitro studies have
modes.description: "have" follows "in vitro studies" or similar, just before a verb like shown or confirmed.
modes.example: In vitro studies<< have>> shown no binding displacement between entacap

modes.label: Other study subjects
modes.description: "have" follows other study nouns such as experiments or interaction studies in humans.
modes.example: Interaction studies in humans<< have>> shown no effect on digoxin blood

card.writes: It boosts "shows/showed/showing", predicting that the next word is a verb meaning "show".
card.plain: It marks the spot where "in vitro studies have" is about to be followed by "shown".
